svg.title: FIG-10 Source SDK 独立消费 搬移完整 prefix；Native 运行与 ARM 链接分别验证 FIG-10 Independent Source SDK consumers relocate full prefix; Native run != ARM link
svg.desc: clean Git source + 锁定依赖 / 许可 开发 fixture 必须显式 opt-in clean Git source / locked deps / licenses development fixtures require explicit opt-in; package_source_sdk.prepare / verify 安装 prefix + manifest + 必需文件闭包 complete prefix / manifest / required files; 移动完整 prefix 到独立路径 不只移动 share/nexus/src relocate complete prefix to a new root not only the source subtree; 独立 consumer source / build find_package(Nexus EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED) 外部 NEXUS_ASSEMBLY_FILE independent consumer source / build external NEXUS_ASSEMBLY_FILE; SDK.cmake / resolver 边界 verify 实际文件 hash / source / 依赖 / closure verify SDK bytes at every public boundary actual hashes / source / deps / closure; nexus_add_firmware() 公共 Nexus targets；SDK/provider headers 不泄漏 public Nexus targets, no vendor header leaks; Native consumer 实际 configure / build / run 验证返回码与生产接口合同 actual Native configure / build / run exit codes and production contracts; ARM consumer 真实 startup/system/linker + ELF/BIN/map 检查选定模式、资源、kernel linkage actual ARM startup / system / link / artifacts selected modes, resources, kernel linkage; 陈旧身份 / 改字节 / 缺闭包 / 错 prefix 拒绝生成或编译，不继续使用 stale 包 stale identity / bytes / closure / prefix reject without using stale outputs; verify_consumers 报告 + raw + 同产物身份 ARM 链接不是实板运行 consumer report, raw logs, artifact identity ARM linking is not physical execution; 实际打包 actual packaging; 完整包 complete package; 独立安装消费 independent installation consumer; 加载公共入口 load public entry; 通过 validated; 失败 failure; Native 配置 Native assembly; 精确 MCU 配置 exact MCU assembly; 实际结果 executed results; 实际结果 executed results
